raw.comments: Repair only `Tablet/FinitePrefixExtension.tex`; preserve its Lean statement, imports, and support structure. For empty s, explicitly use the identity enumeration, prove it is in IncSeq, identify its range, and give 0 as the proper-prefix witness.
